note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors; Co. Londonderry polled on Thursday 5 June 1952. 'Of the twenty-one retiring members of Coleraine Rural Council nineteen were yesterday returned unopposed', with contests likely only in Garvagh and Articlave, where the former members Rev. J. C. Williamson and H. Morrell were opposed (Derry Journal, 21 May 1952, p. 2; Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1952, p. 10). Council-meeting method: division inferred from the 2 June 1949 return (J. W. Stewart; Irish News, 18 May 1949, p. 3); the member was elected chairman at the new council's annual meeting on 10 June 1952 (printed 'J. S. Stewart', Derry Journal, 11 June 1952, p. 5; 'Mr. J. W. Stewart, J.P.', Derry Journal, 23 June 1952, p. 5). As every retiring member was returned, and he or she was the division's member in 1949, he or she was the member returned for it. No co-option or by-election in the division was found in the 1952 reports read. Returned unopposed.
